result.title: ExplicitIR: Explicit Spatial Policy Fields for All-in-One Image Restoration
result.summary: All-in-one image restoration aims to recover clean images blindly from inputs with various degradation types and levels using a single model. However, the adaptation policy in most existing methods remains implicitly encoded in feature representations, leaving the restoration decision neither explicitly represented nor independently controllable. Since real-world degradations vary spatially, applying uniform updates across the entire image leads to over-smoothing of clean areas and under-correction of localized degradations. To address these limitations, we present ExplicitIR, which represents the restoration policy as two explicit per-pixel fields: Budget, which determines where and how strongly to update, and Style, which selects between narrow and wide context windows. Specifically, ExplicitIR incorporates a Spatial Policy Estimator (SPE) to predict these fields, explicitly representing the restoration policy and capturing spatially-varying degradations, which are then applied by Policy-Adaptive Decoder Blocks (PADB) through adaptive fusion of narrow- and wide-window responses, enabling independent control and precise local modulation. This design enables spatially-adaptive restoration in a single forward pass, without requiring task labels, prompts, or test-time degradation estimators. Extensive experiments on three-task and five-task benchmarks demonstrate that ExplicitIR achieves performance competitive with the strongest all-in-one baselines.

AI.brief_summary: ExplicitIR 面向「一体化」图像复原，把复原策略显式表示为两张逐像素场：决定更新位置与强度的 Budget 场，以及选择窄/宽上下文窗口的 Style 场，由空间策略估计器预测、再由策略自适应解码块融合两种窗口响应，实现无需任务标签或测试时退化估计的单次前向空间自适应复原。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把隐式编码在特征中的决策改为显式、可独立控制的逐位置场」这一做法，可能为 LVR 中按位置分配更新强度与注意力/上下文跨度的动态计算提供可核查的方法线索，但属于低层图像复原，与推理状态和证据筛选无直接关联。
